## Problem

What concrete problem does this solve? Link the relevant issue or discussion.

## Change

Describe the resulting behavior and any material limitations.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and what they establish. Distinguish browser fixtures,
automated native checks and hands-on installed-app checks.

## Screenshots

For visual changes, include before/after images with fictional or redacted content.

- [ ] The change is focused and targets `dev`.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and the Unreleased changelog are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private recordings, transcripts or model files are included.
